title: SystemMessages
description: Inform your players with automated, customizable system messages that can be conditionally activated.
body:
Inform your players with automated, customizable system messages that can be conditionally activated based on custom conditions using PlaceholderAPI. You can use the chat and the action bar to display messages.

Most of the configuration can be done by editing the plugin's config.yml, which is commented for ease of editing, however you can learn how to set up the SystemMessages on your server in more detail using the video that will be released shortly. Check back here soon.

bStats This plugin collects data on its usage using bStats, which is a common practice for plugins. However, you can opt out of this data collection by setting enabled to false in bStats/config.yml in the plugins folder.
